name: C11 - True North
teaser: New guns and parts from foreign lands
description:
🇨🇦 True North 🇨🇦

Welcome to the True North

Juicy Trudy from Canmore has gotten a hold of some fancy contraband from his last fishing trip and he’s trying to offload it on the cheap.
He’s also recently purchased a Dremel from Canadian Tire and has a few new parts for you to try out.

To unlock the trader, you must complete the quest “Oh, Canada?” from Peacekeeper.

huge shoutout to EpicRangeTime for making the shaders that I use in this mod, go check out his work as well.

Installation

To install, unzip and drop the SPT folder into your SPT install location.

Pistols

Strike Industries Strike 80 (Tan) with Killer Industries Slide, Barrel and Comp, and ETS Transparent Mag

Comes with Killer Industries Slide, Barrel and Comp, and ETS Transparent Mag

Available from Mechanic (LL3).

Glock 34

Slide, regular barrel and threaded barrel for the Glock 17 Frame.

Available from Mechanic (LL2).

Heckler & Koch P30

Concealable German Excellence.

Available from Peacekeeper (LL2 for $, LL1 for trade).

Heckler & Koch P30L

Hello Again Mr. Wick.

Available from Peacekeeper (LL3)

Agency Arms Glock 17 LS

You’ve upgraded, Mr. Wick

Available from Mechanic (LL3).

Ruger Mark IV 22/45

Classic American Plinking

Available from Skier (LL1)

Assault Rifles

VZ-58

Available in long and short barrels for 7.62x39 and long barrel 5.56x45

Galil Ace 32

Available from Mechanic (LL3).

Galil Ace 31

Available from Mechanic (LL3).

Armalite AR-18

Multiple Variants, Available from Skier (LL1).

CMMG AR-15 .22LR Conversion Kit

Includes mag, lower and .22lr specific barrel.

Carbines

American 180 (.22LR)

A swarm of angry bees in the form of a firearm.

Poly Technologies Type 81 SE (Crimson Red)

Aero Precision M5 .308

Has black and camo variants

Norinco SKS-D

SKS that takes AK mags

Bolt Actions

Brugger and Thomet SPR .300

McMillan CS5 .308

LMGs

Ultimax 100

Poly Technologies Type 81 LMG

Keep your eyes out for a boss variant

Helmets and Accessories

Ops-Core FAST SF Helmet

Some spicy boss variants as well

Night Vision

ACTinBlack DTNVS Dual Tactical Night Vision System

Argus Chimera Panoramic Bridge Quad’s

Available in tan and some secret colors

ITT ANPVS-5-A Gen 2 Night Vision System

Armour

Spiritus Systems LV-119

Ferro Concepts Slickster KTAR

Ferro Concepts Slickster Slick

Ferro Concepts FCPC V5 AOR2 Breacher

Weapon Parts & Sights

PPSH Tactical Upgrade Kit

Available at Prapor (LL1)

Delta Point Micro Glock Red Dot

ZenitCo VZOR4 Red Dot with Laser and Illuminator

Works the same as the Wilcox XeBoss, use the change reticle button to turn on the laser. Has Vis/IR/Illum

MFMD 5.56 Muzzle Device

Comes in Black and Tan

PIECE OF MIND X ILLICIT PROVISIONS Multicam Alpine Windowed PMAG

Note: Please let me know if there is any issues, and log files of the issues would be wonderful
custom_ai_disclosure: AI is not being used for image or mesh creation at all. I run some of the text through AI to check for errors and to create the odd item name or description, and to make boilerplate stats and jsons

versions.description:
2.0.0 - Unified API Release

Major Update

  • Combined client and server CommonLib into unified framework
  • New server-side services for custom items, quests, loot, bots, and more
  • Custom item template registration with full client instantiation support
  • Updated guid: use com.wtt.commonlib dependency

Breaking Changes

  • Update BepInDependency from com.aaaWTT.ClientCommonLib to com.wtt.commonlib

See full documentation on GitHub

https://github.com/WelcomeToTarkov/WTT-CommonLib/blob/main/README.md
Now for spt 4.0! Known bugs: Missing a material for muzzle smoke on one of the guns tac slot on p30 is upside down
